title: Vampire Vape Desserts Caramel Latte E-Liquid Shortfill 50ml
description: Caramel Latte by Vampire Vape Desserts Koncept range recreates the familiar warmth of your favourite coffee shop treat, combining deep, roasted Coffee flavour with a drizzle of sweet Caramel and a layer of smooth, steamed milk. This mellow and satisfying vape balances depth and sweetness, making it a go-to choice for those who enjoy dessert and coffee-inspired flavours. With a 70VG/30PG ratio, this high-VG shortfill is ideal for sub-ohm vaping, producing dense clouds and a full-bodied flavour. Each bottle contains 50ml of nicotine-free e-liquid in a 60ml bottle, leaving enough space to add a 10ml nicotine shot if desired. Made in the UK and fully TPD-compliant, Caramel Latte is part of the Vampire Vape Desserts range — a collection of indulgent flavour profiles inspired by familiar favourites. Also available in Freebase 10mls and DIY Concentrates.
